stance_basis: opinion aligns with Mr. Davis but explicitly noted as technical assistance only, not a formal departmental position
summary: The Bureau of Outdoor Recreation (BOR), as part of the U.S. Department of the Interior, was consulted during early coordination regarding Section 4(f) applicability to the Roosevelt School property and the Cook County Forest Preserve District. In a November 7, 1974 letter, BOR indicated its opinion corresponded with that of Mr. Davis (Benjamin O. Davis, Jr., Department of Transportation) but clarified this was technical assistance only and did not represent the Department of the Interior's official position. BOR also indicated, via telephone, that no additional response was needed regarding the Forest Preserve property given the well-documented coordination efforts.
complaint_summary: The Bureau of Outdoor Recreation responded to a request regarding Section 4(f) applicability to the Roosevelt School property, stating that the proper person to make a determination of recreational significance would be the Director of the Park District for Chicago Heights, and that its opinion corresponded with that of Mr. Davis but was provided only as technical assistance and did not represent the Department of the Interior's official position.

statement.text:
4(a) This is in response to your reapplicability of Section 4(f) to the Roosevelt School property, F.A. Route 23 (U.S. 30) Lincoln Highway, Cook County, Illinois. We regret the delay in our response.
4(a) Concur - It is to be noted that our request not only concerned the Roosevelt School property but also an involvement with the Cook County Forest Preserve District by way of a temporary construction easement.
In telephone conversation with Mr. Bob Frantz of the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation on November 14, 1974, Mr. Frantz said no additional response would be forthcoming concerning the Cook County Forest Preserve Property since the material submitted for early coordination and our cooperative efforts with the Forest Preserve District were well documented.
